title: 第903章 洞天闭关第902章 数日论道柳惊天剑道大进
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
踏入本源洞天之内，浓郁到极致的精纯灵气扑面而来。
氤氲霞光笼罩周身，道韵流转，滋养肉身与道心。
他缓步走到洞天密室的蒲团之上，盘膝静坐。
凌宇领悟的本源洞天之力极为特殊，乃是诸天罕见的时空法则之力。
有这等顶级时空之力加持，他的修行速度、悟道效率、底蕴打磨，都远超寻常修士万倍不止。
旁人梦寐以求的长生天修行环境，对他而言早已不算顶尖。
世人皆知，从灵虚境、天人境突破高阶境界，最倚仗的便是长生天的特殊环境。
长生天拥有人间界千倍的时间流速，法则亲近这些中层修士，最适合第五境至第八境修士悟道突破。
寻常修士，唯有扎根长生天，才能快速精进、打破境界桎梏。
但凌宇完全不需要依赖外界地域加持。
他的本源洞天自带顶级时空流速，可随心调控时间快慢。
再配合专属辅助洞天的逆天增幅，时时刻刻拔高他的无上悟性。
辅助洞天内嵌完整三千大道法理，包罗诸天万道规则。
旁人需要远赴域外秘境奇观、踏遍万族疆域才能窥探一丝的法则真谛。
他坐在洞天之中，便可随心感悟、随手参悟。
省去无数奔波苦修的时间，悟道效率碾压同辈天骄。
凌宇心神彻底沉淀，放空所有思绪，摒除一切外界杂念。
随后，他双手一翻，取出此前妥善封存的天罡雷煞以及九幽冥煞。
一缕缕霸道凌厉、至刚至阳的天罡雷煞轰然散开。
狂暴雷霆气息充斥整间密室，撕裂虚妄，淬炼一切杂质。

与此同时，一缕缕幽暗深邃、至阴至寒的九幽冥煞缓缓流转。
阴冷诡秘的冥界煞气缠绕周身，内敛杀伐，浸透筋骨脏腑。
一阳一阴，一雷一冥，两种极致煞气彼此交融、互相平衡。
这便是他此番远赴长生天，历经血战波折，收获的最核心修行资源。
也是他突破桎梏、精进功法的唯一关键底牌。
凌宇心中无比清楚。
他所修炼的《混元无极真经》，走的是阴阳合一、混元归一的无上大道。
功法特殊，修行苛刻，必须依靠顶级阴阳双煞调和淬炼。
没有六阶天罡雷煞、九幽冥煞这两种六阶顶级煞气加持。
他的混元无极真经，永远卡在当前层次，再也无法寸进。
凌宇目光沉静如水，心中早已定下清晰无比的闭关目标。
此番闭关，首要任务，便是借两种顶级阴阳煞气的磅礴伟力。
全方位打磨肉身根基，将两种煞气之力炼入体内窍穴经脉。
彻底淬炼道体本源，一举将肉身境界推至第六境圆满。
此番收获的阴阳煞气量极其充裕，完全足够支撑他圆满突破。
不仅能将《混元无极真经》推演至全新的极致层次。
更能彻底夯实第六境所有根基，不留半点瑕疵短板。
肉身突破之余，他还要借洞天道韵与阴阳煞气滋养元神。
将自身元神修为，稳稳推进至第六境圆满巅峰。
做到肉身、元神、功法三重圆满，根基无懈可击。

若是闭关过程顺利，无人打扰、心境圆满。
他便顺势一鼓作气，直接冲破桎梏，踏入第七境灵源境！
content_en:
Stepping into the Origin Cave, the extremely rich and pure spiritual energy hit your face.
The dense rays of rays of light envelope the whole body, and the rhythm of the Tao flows, nourishing the physical body and the Tao mind.
He walked slowly to the futon in the cave's secret room and sat cross-legged in silence.
The power of the original cave that Ling Yu comprehended was extremely special, and it was the power of the law of time and space that is rare in the heavens.
With the blessing of such top-level power of time and space, his cultivation speed, enlightenment efficiency, and foundation refinement are far more than ten thousand times higher than those of ordinary monks.
The cultivation environment of Changshengtian that others dream of is no longer top-notch for him.
Everyone knows that the most important thing to break through from the spiritual realm and the heavenly realm to the high-level realm is the special environment of the Immortal Heaven.
Changshengtian has a time flow speed a thousand times that of the human world. The law is close to these middle-level monks, and is most suitable for monks in the fifth to eighth realms to achieve enlightenment and breakthrough.
Ordinary monks can only make rapid progress and break the shackles of realm by taking root in the Immortal Heaven.
But Ling Yu does not need to rely on external geographical blessings at all.
His Origin Cave has a top-level space-time flow speed, and he can control the speed of time at will.
Coupled with the heaven-defying increase of the exclusive auxiliary Dongtian, his supreme understanding is always enhanced.
The auxiliary cave is embedded with the complete legal principles of three thousand avenues, including all the laws of the heavens.
Others need to go far to see the wonders of secret realms outside the territory and travel across the borders of all races to get a glimpse of the true meaning of the law.
Sitting in the cave, he can feel and understand at will.
It saves countless hours of hard work, and the efficiency of enlightenment crushes the geniuses of the same generation.
Ling Yu's mind completely calmed down, letting go of all thoughts and eliminating all external distractions.
Then, he turned over his hands and took out the Tiangang Leisha and Jiuyou Mingsha that had been properly sealed before.
Wisps of domineering, fierce, and extremely strong Tiangang Leisha suddenly dispersed.
The violent thunder aura filled the entire secret room, tearing apart illusions and tempering all impurities.
At the same time, wisps of the dark, deep, gloomy and cold Nine Netherworld Evil slowly circulated.
The cold and mysterious evil spirit of the underworld wraps around the body, killing with restraint and soaking into the muscles, bones and internal organs.
One yang and one yin, one thunder and one dark, two extreme evil spirits blend with each other and balance each other.
This is the core cultivation resource that he gained from going to the Immortal Heaven and going through the twists and turns of the bloody battle.
It is also the only key trump card for him to break through the shackles and improve his skills.
Ling Yu knew it very well.
The "Hunyuan Wuji Sutra" he practiced followed the supreme path of integrating yin and yang and Hunyuan into one.
The technique is special and the practice is demanding. It must rely on the coordination and tempering of the top yin and yang evil spirits.
There is no blessing from the two top level six evil spirits, Tiangang Thunder Evil and Nine Netherworld Evil.
His Hunyuan Wuji Sutra is always stuck at the current level and can no longer advance.
Ling Yu's eyes were as calm as water, and he had already set a very clear goal of retreat in his heart.
The first task of this retreat is to borrow the majestic power of two top-level yin and yang evil spirits.
Polish the foundation of the physical body in all directions and refine the power of the two evil spirits into the orifices and meridians of the body.
Thoroughly temper the origin of the Tao body and push the realm of the physical body to the sixth level of perfection in one fell swoop.
The amount of yin and yang evil energy harvested this time is extremely abundant, which is completely enough to support his successful breakthrough.
Not only can the "Hunyuan Wuji Sutra" be deduced to a new and ultimate level.
It can also completely consolidate all the foundations of the Sixth Realm without leaving any flaws or shortcomings.
In addition to the breakthrough of his physical body, he also needs to nourish his soul with the help of the Taoist Rhythm of the Cave Heaven and the evil energy of Yin and Yang.
Cultivation of one's own soul will steadily advance to the sixth level of perfection.
Achieve the triple perfection of body, soul, and skills, and have an impeccable foundation.
If the retreat process goes smoothly, no one will disturb you, and your mood will be perfect.
He then took advantage of the situation and broke through the shackles directly, stepping into the seventh realm of spiritual source!
